info.title: Info & Privacy
info.description: All the info you need to get started with UChat

privacy_items.item_1: Your Twitch token is never stored; it is only sent to the server when needed to authenticate actions like login, saving, or deleting your settings.
privacy_items.item_2: Settings you change are saved only in your browser so they stay after refresh or returning to the page; they are not stored on our servers unless you are a tester saving global settings.
privacy_items.item_3: For testers, we store only their Twitch user ID and the settings they changed from default—nothing else.
privacy_items.item_4: Pressing "Save" updates your saved global settings; "Delete" removes all your saved settings from our servers.
privacy_items.item_5: Using "Reset Settings" clears all locally saved settings in your browser.
privacy_items.item_6: We log requests only when a platform requires our server to provide data. Logged details may include the channel, overlay version, referrer, user agent, cache status, and Cloudflare Ray ID. We don't log or store IP addresses.
privacy_items.item_7: Requests pass through Cloudflare, which processes data separately under its own privacy policy.
privacy_items.item_end: UChat and all services under unii.dev are independent and are not affiliated, endorsed by, or sponsored by Twitch Interactive, Inc., YouTube, LLC, or Kick Streaming Pty Ltd.

item_1.question: What is UChat?
item_1.answer: UChat is an open-source (AGPL-3.0-or-later) multiplatform chat overlay for Twitch, Kick, and YouTube that supports 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ emotes.

item_2.question: How do I get my overlay URL?
item_2.answer: After adding your channel and customizing your settings, the overlay URL will appear in the 'Overlay URL' section where you can copy it using the copy button.

item_3.question: Who made UChat?
item_3.answer: UChat was made by {uniidev} with the help of {ftk789} & {creepycode}.

item_4.question: What chat commands are available?
item_4.answer: Commands can only be used by the broadcaster or a mod; you can also use commands with !uchat <command>. Click to copy a command.

commands.chatversion: Shows Chat Overlay Version (reuse command to disable)
commands.hideloading: Hides the loading UI (e.g. if an API is down)
commands.multichat: Disables multiplatform badges (reuse command to enable)

item_5.question: What is YAUTO?
item_5.answer: YAUTO, short for "Yet Another Useless Twitch Overlay," was the former name of this project. It was renamed to UChat on August 2, 2025 for a cleaner and more recognizable name.

item_7.question: Why is there a login button?
item_7.answer: Early testers of UChat can log in to save their settings globally. This way, they only need to enter their channel name without using a long overlay URL.

item_8.question: How do the Save and Delete buttons work for testers?
item_8.answer: Pressing Save updates only the settings you've changed on the server linked to your user ID. Delete removes all your saved global settings from the server. Local browser settings aren't affected by Delete.

item_9.question: What are the chances of becoming a tester?
item_9.answer: The testing phase is over. Currently, no new testers are being accepted.

item_10.question: Why do my settings stay after refreshing?
item_10.answer: They are saved in your browser. Click 'Reset Settings' to reset.

item_11.question: Where can I find the API?
item_11.answer: You can access the public API documentation here.

item_12.question: Can I use this overlay or its API for my own project?
item_12.answer: Yes, you can use the documented public API and embed the overlay in your own project, but undocumented endpoints are off limits. The "Embed of" credit must stay visible. Covering it will get your website blocked globally, and so will bypassing restrictions (e.g. CORS). Everything is provided as is: we're not responsible if something breaks or if we change how things work.

item_13.question: Where can I find the source code?
item_13.answer: You can find the source code on {github}.

item_14.question: Is my Twitch token safe?
item_14.answer: Your token is only used for validation and is never stored on our servers.

item_15.question: What does our error tracking collect?
item_15.answer: We log error messages, stack traces, and basic browser/OS data when an error or crash happens. We don't record sessions or intentionally collect personal data. This data is only shared with our error-tracking provider, Better Stack.

item_16.question: Why don't some FFZ emote effects work?
item_16.answer: Some FFZ emote effects are sub-only, and some need changes to how emotes are rendered. We're planning to support them while respecting the sub-only limits.

item_17.question: Is UChat affected by recent CVEs?
item_17.answer: We keep UChat updated with known security fixes, but may not learn about new CVEs immediately. We patch issues affecting UChat as soon as possible. Please report any security issues.

item_end.question: What if my question isn't listed here?
item_end.answer: For more information, you can reach out via {twitch} or {discord}.
